description: This script is a test suite for Git's diff functionality, specifically testing the 'diff-files' command with various options. It creates files, modifies permissions, generates diffs, and compares expected outputs to actual results to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test with a descriptive name expecting it to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the actual diff output with the expected diff patch.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
